display_name: WiSig R17 保持约束实频谱增益源域筛查
description: 冻结完整 R17，学习接收信号与其输出差值的实频谱增益，使用源域波形和 R17 保持损失，在未筛查源 RX6 上评估。
authorization: 当前聊天 01a2204f-647a-7903-ba29-81cfe8f8749b 的融合研发目标及 N607 有显存即启动要求。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32 TF32off; independent CPU scorer

data.representation: 256 complex points, 8 x 32 groups; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head for evaluation only
data.physical_ids_ref: all 360 source V physical IDs with RX=6; disjoint from previous RX1/3/4 screens
data.label_map_ref: Original six classes; no L/U TX label used in training, source V label only after independent freeze
data.train_ratio: 7/63/30; use 52604 U after existing calibration exclusion
data.validation_ref: Reuse existing registered source cache and validated source roles
data.leo_config_ref: Registered source Full clean and practical_low_urban

permissions.claim_scope: Only source U_s IQ and simulated paired disturbances. Frozen R17/realgain IQ models; no F weights or outputs in fit, no TX labels or V/target. Source V labels only in independent scorer after all two-view predictions fixed.

checkpoint.initialization: New real spectral gain head zero initialized; full WiSig R17 frozen. Independent same-contract realgain and first physical fusion used as evaluation controls only.

sources.role: WiSig source-only realgain and prior physical-gain candidate as frozen controls; source V RX1 already exposed
Full unroll_unshared R17 E20/4940; source-only TX-free F-free training
WiSig source U-trained PacketUNet parent of realgain

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original F0 source roles, existing validation_full IDs, strict source-only frozen checkpoint proofs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No LoRa checkpoints used. WiSig source U-only parents and fixed source-selected R17 have compatible original contract; prior RX1 screen used for development.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 2000 updates. On RX6 low urban require net >=2 in each deterministic half vs direct, R17, WiSig realgain and first fusion, and clean net >=-2 vs each. Paired bootstrap reported.

execution.gpu_policy: One worker on first GPU with >=8192 MiB free in order 7,2,3,6,1,4,0,5; LoRa GPU5 protected.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on mismatched source roles or checkpoints, nonfinite values or absent first-step gain gradient, collision, incomplete predictions or scorer failure. Preserve other owners and partial results.

rows.method: Frozen full R17 plus real spectral gain on received-minus-R17 innovation, source IQ fit with explicit R17 preservation.
rows.seed_notes: No support; evaluation seed assigns sample halves, RX6 uses all 360 existing IDs.
rows.budget_ref: 2000 updates x 24 U_s, 48000 unlabeled exposures; inherited model training costs separate

notes: Prior RX1/3/4 source screens exposed; this fixed RX6 source panel uses different physical IDs.
The current adaptation and R17 are trained only with source U and no TX labels or F; LoRa weights are not used.
Loss = waveform MSE + 0.3 spectral error + 1.5 clean R17 retention + 2.0 disturbed R17 retention. Fixed LR and budget; no target data used.
Frozen classifier runs after fitting; source V truth opens only after both prediction views freeze.
Fixed DURA v1 and full target seven-view evaluation remain outstanding; historical target benchmark exposed.
